prose: Alibaba CEO Eddie Wu says the company plans to train an AI model with 5 trillion to 10 trillion parameters, Reuters reports, part of a sweeping push across AI models, chips and data centers. The model would be up to four times larger than the company's current flagship.
highlights: Alibaba plans a 5T- to 10T-parameter model, per CEO Eddie Wu.
That is up to four times larger than its current flagship model.
The plan is part of a broader push across models, chips and data centers.
